Cassiopeia|mid.identity: Magic damage DPS mage, played mid about two games out of three. Her poisons (Noxious Blast, Q, and Miasma, W) make Twin Fang (E) very fast and powerful; W also prevents dashes. Petrifying Gaze (R) petrifies enemies facing her. Her passive makes all her speed bonuses more effective.
Cassiopeia|mid.playstyle: Extended-fight mage: poison, then spam E. She becomes very strong in teamfights with her items.
Cassiopeia|mid.early_game: Farm with E (mana refunded if the minion dies) and poke with Q when your opponent comes to last hit. Keep W against assassins (it prevents their dashes). You're vulnerable to long-range poke: stay behind your minions.
Cassiopeia|mid.level_1: Twin Fang (E) first. Last hit safely.
Cassiopeia|mid.level_2: Noxious Blast (Q). Q, then chain E on the poisoned opponent.
Cassiopeia|mid.level_3: Miasma (W). It slows and prevents dashes: keep it against an assassin's engage.
Cassiopeia|mid.level_6: Petrifying Gaze: petrifies enemies facing you. Combined with W, it shuts down almost any escape or engage.
power_spikes: Two to three items: a dominant extended-fight mage.
Cassiopeia|mid.lane_plan: Farm with E and poke with Q. Keep the wave in the middle or near you against assassins. Push before joining your jungler. Avoid staying exposed to long-range mages.
Cassiopeia|mid.trading: Basic trade: Q, then repeated E's. Long trade: W to prevent escapes, R to petrify. Engage if your Q lands; give up on it against mages who poke you from out of range.
threats: Long-range and burst mages (Syndra, Hwei, Veigar).
Assassins who arrive while W is on cooldown (Qiyana, LeBlanc).
mistakes: Using W to farm and not having it against an engage.
Casting your ultimate at the enemy's back.
Draining your mana with E on unpoisoned minions.

matchup_notes.Viktor: He pokes you: dodge his laser and fight when you can poison him.
matchup_notes.Syndra: She pokes and stuns you: stay behind your minions.
matchup_notes.Ahri: Keep W for her dashes and R for her engage.
matchup_notes.Sylas: W prevents his dashes; careful, he can steal your ultimate.
matchup_notes.Yasuo: W prevents his dashes; his Wind Wall blocks your Q, not your E.

Cassiopeia|mid.mid_game: Join objectives and farm waves from range. W and R defend very well.
Cassiopeia|mid.late_game: Main area DPS: stand behind your frontline, poison and spam E. Keep R for the enemy engage.
Cassiopeia|mid.ahead: Take towers and objectives, roam with your jungler.
Cassiopeia|mid.behind: Farm and scale: your late game makes up for being behind.
Cassiopeia|mid.win_condition: To win this game, you want to survive the lane and dominate teamfights with your poison.
Cassiopeia|mid.final_tip: Keep Miasma for the enemy engage: stopping a dash is worth more than any poke.
